description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [MAG and RES +30% (25s)], [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Awoken Witch], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Retribution] to the user

description.name: Awoken Witch
description.text: Witch abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Witch abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Retribution
description.text: Grants [Lightning +50% Boost 1] to the user after using two Lightning abilities
